title: Game options: help mark after the title, one line description, reset by title
covers: OptionFieldRow help mark, one line description, reset, flush right inputs
context: In the options screen of a preset each row has one help (?) right after the title, a description clipped to one line, a reset icon next to the title only after you change the value, and every input flush at the right edge. A preset left at its defaults saves without a medallion error, and a refused value is listed with a link that jumps to its option.
changed: views/PresetEditor: save blocks and the fix list

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

steps: Open the menu, Library, Presets. Press New preset. Type the name Options check, pick the game A Link to the Past, leave Start from as it is, and press Create.

Look at any option row, for example Goal. Right after the title there is one small ? mark. No reset icon and no Changed mark show yet. Hover the ? of Entrance Shuffle, then click it, then Tab to it: the full help text shows each time.
The description under the title is one line only, cut at the row edge. Every input (a switch, a choice, a text box) ends at the same right edge and none runs over the title or the ?.
Turn Swordless on. Next to its title, after the ?, a reset icon and the mark Changed appear. No other row has them. Press the reset icon: the switch goes off and both disappear.

Turn Swordless on again. Leave Misery Mire Medallion and Turtle Rock Medallion at random. Press Save in the bar at the bottom. A toast says Saved the preset Options check, with no message about a medallion.

Type plando in the option search box and find Plando Items. In its code box type the broken text {oops and click outside. A red box titled 1 thing to fix before saving lists Plando Items with a JSON message, and Save is blocked.

Clear the search box, open a different tab and scroll away. Press the entry in the red box. The editor goes back to the tab of Plando Items, shows Advanced options if needed, scrolls to the row and puts the cursor in its box.
Replace the text with [] (two square brackets). The red box disappears and Save works again. Press Discard in the Save bar to leave the preset as it was.
pass: Each row has one ? right after the title, a one line description, and a reset icon only after a change.
Every input is flush right and nothing overlaps the title.
A preset with one option changed saves with no medallion error.
A refused option is listed above the options and the entry jumps to it, even from another tab or a search.
fail: The ? is missing, sits at the far right, or the description runs over more than one line.
A reset icon shows on a row nobody changed, or does not show after a change.
An input is not at the right edge or overlaps text.
Saving mentions Misery Mire Medallion or Turtle Rock Medallion, or the fix list is missing or its link lands on the wrong option.
notes: If Plando Items is not found, use any option with a code box, for example Plando Texts or Plando Connections.
Check the contrast in both light and dark themes if the app offers both. Optional.
The owner result on this test was partial in an earlier bundle. Say in your note which part of the rows still looks wrong.
